product_overview: A React + Vite based employee management portal that allows admins and HR to manage employees, departments, tasks, and applications while employees can view and act on assigned tasks and their profiles.
core_goals: Provide secure user authentication for employees and admins.
Give admins/HR the ability to add and manage employee records and departments.
Enable task assignment and tracking for employees and managers.
Surface application and department data for administrative decision-making.
Protect authenticated routes and redirect unauthenticated users to login.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to authenticate using email and password, then access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with invalid email or password -> Click Login button to submit -> See inline authentication error on /login
Navigate to /dashboard while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated landing area showing overall stats such as employee counts and department breakdowns.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See overall stats and department breakdown displayed
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Employees section or link -> Navigate to /employees
Navigate to /dashboard while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Add Employee
features.description: Admins or HR can create new employee records via the employees page.
user_flows: Navigate to /employees -> Click Add Employee button -> Fill add employee form -> Click save -> See new employee appear in the employees list
Navigate to /employees -> Click Add Employee button -> Leave required field empty in add employee form -> Click save -> See validation error message on /employees
Navigate to /employees while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: View Employee Profile
features.description: View detailed information for a specific employee from the employees list or profile route.
user_flows: Navigate to /employees -> Click an employee entry -> Navigate to /employee/:id -> See employee profile details
Navigate to /employee/:id while authenticated -> See profile details and related actions
Navigate to /employee/:id while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Departments View
features.description: Show departments list and breakdown to admins and allow navigation to department details.
user_flows: Navigate to /departments -> See list of departments and counts
Navigate to /departments -> Click a department item -> See department detail or filtered employee list
Navigate to /departments while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Applications
features.description: Display and manage incoming applications within the applications page.
user_flows: Navigate to /applications -> See list of applications and statuses
Navigate to /applications -> Click an application entry -> See application details
Navigate to /applications while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Tasks (Manager View)
features.description: Managers can view and manage tasks, including creating and assigning tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /tasks -> See list of tasks and statuses
Navigate to /assign-task -> Fill task details -> Click Assign -> See new task appear in /tasks
Navigate to /assign-task -> Fill task details with missing required field -> Click Assign -> See validation error on /assign-task
Navigate to /tasks while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: My Tasks (Employee View)
features.description: Employees can view tasks assigned to them on the my-tasks page and update progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-tasks -> See list of tasks assigned to the logged-in employee
Navigate to /my-tasks -> Click a task -> Update status or progress -> See task status updated in /my-tasks
Navigate to /my-tasks while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login

features.name: Waiting / Pending State
features.description: Show a waiting or pending state for operations that require processing or approval.
user_flows: Navigate to /waiting -> See waiting message or spinner indicating pending operation
Trigger an operation that requires approval -> Be redirected to /waiting -> See pending state until operation completes
Navigate to /waiting while unauthenticated -> See redirect to /login
